title: Finitely presented cokernels on locally Noetherian schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $M,N$ be quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], with $N$ of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. For every $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism $\varphi:M\to N$, the categorical cokernel of $\varphi$ is of finite presentation.

source.place: Tag 01Y1 (cohomology-lemma-coherent-sub-quotient), quotient clause, together with Tag 01XZ; exact finite-presentation form proved in lean/WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/QuasicoherentCokernel.lean, lines 79-107

proof.text: Apply the existing closed source declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFinitePresentation_cokernel with the same scheme and morphism. Its proof computes the cokernel of quasi-coherent modules on affine opens by exact restriction and the tilde equivalence. Sections of N on each Noetherian affine open are finite; their quotient giving cokernel sections is finite by Module.Finite.of_surjective. A finite module over a Noetherian ring has a finite presentation. The affine tilde comparison and locality of finite presentation glue these finite presentations. This records an already proved source-library result, without adding a Lean declaration or any proof hole.

theorem isFinitePresentation_cokernel [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {M N : X.Modules}
    [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent (R := X.ringCatSheaf) M]
    [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent (R := X.ringCatSheaf) N]
    [SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation (R := X.ringCatSheaf) N] (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (cokernel φ)
